⚡CloudSync Pro

Frequently Asked Questions

Find quick answers to common questions about CloudSync Pro

General

What is CloudSync Pro?

CloudSync Pro is a comprehensive cloud synchronization and file management platform designed for teams and individuals. It allows you to securely store, sync, and share files across all your devices with advanced collaboration features, version control, and enterprise-grade security.

Who should use CloudSync Pro?

CloudSync Pro is ideal for freelancers, small businesses, creative teams, and enterprises that need reliable file synchronization, secure sharing, and seamless collaboration. Whether you're working solo or managing a team of hundreds, CloudSync Pro scales to your needs.

Is CloudSync Pro secure?

Yes. CloudSync Pro uses end-to-end encryption for all files, advanced access controls, two-factor authentication, and regular security audits. We comply with SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA standards. Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

Setup

How do I get started with CloudSync Pro?

Getting started is simple: (1) Visit our website and click "Sign Up", (2) Enter your email and create a password, (3) Verify your email address, (4) Download the CloudSync Pro app for your device, (5) Log in and start syncing files. You'll have 5 GB of free storage to begin with.

Which devices and operating systems does CloudSync Pro support?

CloudSync Pro is available on Windows (7 and later), macOS (10.12 and later), iOS (13.0+), Android (8.0+), and Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian). We also offer a web app accessible from any modern browser. Sync works seamlessly across all devices.

Can I sync files selectively or do all files have to sync?

You have full control. You can choose which folders and files to sync on each device using our selective sync feature. This is helpful if you have limited storage on mobile devices or want to keep sensitive files on specific computers only.

Billing

What storage plans does CloudSync Pro offer?

We offer flexible plans: Free (5 GB), Essential ($9.99/month, 500 GB), Professional ($19.99/month, 2 TB), and Business ($49.99/month, unlimited storage). Billed annually, all plans receive a 20% discount. Storage is per account and shared across all synced devices.

Do you offer a free trial?

Yes! Everyone starts with our Free plan offering 5 GB of storage at no cost. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time. Paid plans come with a 14-day money-back guarantee, so you can try them risk-free.

Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

Absolutely. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings with no penalties or hidden fees. If you paid monthly, your access continues until the end of the current billing cycle. For annual plans, you may request a prorated refund if you cancel early.

Support

How do I contact CloudSync Pro support?

You can reach our support team via email at support@cloudsyncpro.com, phone at 1-800-555-1234 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM EST), or through the live chat feature in your account dashboard. Response times are typically under 2 hours during business hours.

What if files don't sync between my devices?

First, ensure all devices are connected to the internet and you're logged into the same account. Check that selective sync isn't filtering out the files you're trying to sync. Restart the CloudSync Pro app, and if the issue persists, check our status page at status.cloudsyncpro.com or contact support for troubleshooting help.
